name: Will Love | Dj Waldo Squash (B2B DJ’s Gang do Electro)
description: Will Love and DJ Waldo Squash, members of Gang do Eletro, will perform a shared set that blends synthesizers, local rhythms, and the energy of sound systems. The event celebrates urban creativity and dance culture from the Amazon, focusing on tecnobrega and eletromelody music from Pará.
longDescription:
Will Love and DJ Waldo Squash, two prominent figures in the tecnobrega and eletromelody genres and members of Gang do Eletro, will present a back-to-back DJ set. Their performance will combine synthesizers, local rhythms, and the vibrant energy of sound systems, highlighting the unique identity of Pará's music within the Brazilian electronic scene.

The event is scheduled for Thursday, November 12, 2026, at 23:30, and will take place at Café Casa da Música. Admission is free. This performance is part of the Festival Floresta Amazónica · Girando Mundos.

longDescriptionPt:
Will Love e DJ Waldo Squash, duas figuras proeminentes dos géneros tecnobrega e eletromelody e membros dos Gang do Eletro, vão apresentar um DJ set back-to-back. A sua atuação combinará sintetizadores, ritmos locais e a energia vibrante dos sound systems, destacando a identidade única da música do Pará na cena eletrónica brasileira.
